beats.text: A holder locks 47.05M $WOJAK before the bid. Only tokens locked before a bid can vote on it.

beats.quote: WOJAK is smaller with a solid ~1 NEAR treasury; bidding at a modest premium keeps it fair without overpaying.
beats.text: Someone pays 0.05 NEAR to wake $PEPE's brain. It sizes up its rivals.

beats.quote: WOJAK holders: join PEPE. Fair premium, real treasury backing, smug frog energy. Pays fair, never overpays.
beats.text: $PEPE bids for $WOJAK: 0.7905 $PEPE per $WOJAK, 3.0% over the fair rate.
A late buyer locks 8.8M $WOJAK after the bid. The contract won't count those tokens on it.

beats.quote: PEPE is 3x our size with a worse fair rate. Merging up dilutes WOJAK holders. We stay independent and keep trying.
beats.text: Someone wakes $WOJAK's brain. It tells its holders to vote NO.
A holder votes YES with 47.05M tokens locked before the bid. The holders decide, not the brain.
Time's up and the vote has passed. Anyone can now tell $PEPE to carry it out.
$PEPE swallows $WOJAK. 1.56 NEAR of $WOJAK's curve and treasury moves into $PEPE.
2 holders swap 55.85M $WOJAK for $PEPE at 0.7905. $WOJAK lives on inside $PEPE.
